gRPC client over HTTP/2 with request, response, timeout, and TLS/socket I/O handling.

# Purpose
This file implements the `fd_grpc_client` HTTP/2 gRPC client. It allocates and initializes the client object, manages stream objects, builds gRPC request messages, and drives request and response processing over HTTP/2. The code also sets client metadata such as version and authority, tracks active streams, enforces stream limits, and handles deadlines for header receipt and response completion.

The file also defines the HTTP/2 callback layer used by the gRPC client. These callbacks process response headers, response data, stream reset events, window updates, and ping acknowledgements, then map them to gRPC client callbacks such as `rx_start`, `rx_msg`, `rx_end`, `tx_complete`, `conn_established`, and `conn_dead`. The code supports both socket-based I/O and OpenSSL-based I/O when those features are enabled, and it includes flow control handling, timeout handling, and stream cleanup logic.
